title: Drug Interaction Study of Azithromycin and Theophylline
brief_summary: Macrolides are potent inhibitors of cytochrome P450 isoenzyme 3A4（CYP3A4）and thus interfere with the pharmacokinetics of many other drugs that are metabolised by this enzyme like theophylline.The aim of this study is to determine whether azithromycin can effect theophylline metabolism in patients.
